run_generate_samples_from_file: run GPT2 text generation from input prompts in a file using the Megatron model parallel setup
run_generate_samples_interactive: run interactive GPT2 text generation by typing context prompts in the terminal
run_generate_samples_unconditional: run unconditional GPT2 text generation and write JSON output samples to a file
build_gpt2_model: build a GPT2 model with configurable layers, hidden size, attention heads, and FP16 support
apply_top_k_top_p_filtering: apply top-k and top-p nucleus filtering to model logits for controlled text sampling
